io.milvus.bulkwriter.common.clientenum

Enum CloudStorage

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<CloudStorage>
      • io.milvus.bulkwriter.common.clientenum.CloudStorage
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, Comparable<CloudStorage>

    public enum CloudStorage
extends Enum<CloudStorage>
    Cloud storage providers supported by the Milvus BulkWriter, together with their endpoint templates and the endpoint placeholder they replace.
